query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS smsLogs (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  type ENUM('login','register','bind') DEFAULT 'login' NOT NULL,
  code VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending','success','failed') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  aliyunCode VARCHAR(20),
  aliyunMessage TEXT,
  errorReason TEXT,
  requestedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  respondedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX smsLogs_phone_idx (phone),
  INDEX smsLogs_status_idx (status)
);
